text:
maya: quick run results for the mosaic-avg-13b q4_hybrid bring-up across eu/us/ap. seeing unexpected warmup variance + scheduler handoff noise between pools. pasting short summary and logs. TL;DR: h100-eu stable; a100-us shows p99 spikes on handoff; g8-ap steady but slightly lower throughput.

sahil: can you paste exact config and batcher params?

maya: config below: 
```
model: mosaic-avg-13b
quant: q4_hybrid
batcher: continuous
batch_window_ms: 16
max_batch_tokens: 2048
kv_prefetch: false
fairness_weights: default
routing_policy: region-first -> capacity-fallback
```

jordan: what do you mean by "handoff noise"? is it autoscale slot migration?

maya: yeah, when requests are moved from warm pool -> new slot during burst, KV cache misses + kernel fallback decision causes ~200-400ms p99 blips on a100-us. observed across both canary and full runs.

ops-bot: deploy: mosaic-avg-13b q4_hybrid @ h100-eu1, a100-us2, g8-ap3 completed (2268010501) :white_check_mark:

liam: raw numbers from the 20k sample: 
```
h100-eu1: p95=42ms p99=120ms throughput=260 tok/s
a100-us2: p95=68ms p99=320ms throughput=176 tok/s (p99 spikes aligned w/ handoff window)
g8-ap3:  p95=55ms p99=200ms throughput=210 tok/s
```

anika: try kv_prefetch=true + lower batch_window to 12ms, that reduces KV cold misses and forces earlier batching. also try forcing kernel=cuBLAS/cutlass to see if kernel selection jitter is involved.

sahil: +1 to forcing kernel. Also try max_batch_tokens=1024 to reduce burst packing variance. Can you run a quick AB with kv_prefetch on/off?

maya: reran a short AB with kv_prefetch=true, batch_window_ms=12, max_batch_tokens=2048. results: a100-us p99 drops from 320 -> 210ms, throughput -5%. h100 unaffected. g8 slight improvement p99 200 -> 185ms.

jordan: did you capture latency CDFs or connection of spikes to specific handoff events?

maya: yes — plotted alignment: most p99s cluster exactly at handoff timestamps (autoscale or slot recycling). link to chart: https://rwd/bench/2268 (internal)

anika: also check kernel trace: when handoff happens we see transient fallback to generic aten kernels for some ops for ~2-3 requests before cutlass resumes. that explains the p99 inflation.

liam: quick grep from logs: 
```
[2268010622] slot-migrate: src=poolA dst=poolB requests=8
[2268010622] kernel=aten_fallback for op=matmul seq=118..120
[2268010623] kernel=cutlass_fast resumed
```

sahil: ok so action: (1) rerun with kv_prefetch=true + batch_window=12ms + max_batch_tokens=1024, (2) force kernel=cutlass on a100-us for a short run, (3) run eval set for quality regression q4_hybrid vs q4o, (4) verify fairness weights not causing extra evictions.

maya: ran eval quick check q4_hybrid vs q4o on our 3k prompt eval: token-level quality close, but short-prompt hallucination rate +0.8% on q4_hybrid; overall ROUGE delta ~-0.2. will run full eval next.

jordan: do we have a throughput vs latency per-tenant breakdown? wondering if large-chat tenants are hitting max_batch_tokens and causing coalescing delays.

maya: attached short per-tenant table in chart (internal). summary: two high-throughput tenants hit max_batch_tokens and saw slightly higher latency variance; smaller tenants unaffected.

anika: proposed experiment: (A) kv_prefetch=true + kernel=cutlass + max_batch_tokens=1024 (B) kv_prefetch=false + kernel=cutlass + max_batch_tokens=1024. Run both on a100-us2 and compare p95/p99 and throughput.

maya: will run both tomorrow morning and post results. opening tracking issue rwd-infra#2268 with steps + seed logs. cc @sahil @anika

sahil: thanks — if cutlass reduces p99 but drops throughput too much we might instead prefer a hybrid: force cutlass only during handoff events (if we can detect) or pre-warm kernels on slot creation.

liam: note: pre-warm kernels idea should be cheap — we can call a tiny warmup trace on new slot creation to compile/load cutlass kernels.

maya: noted. will include pre-warm probe in the experiment set. will share final numbers and a short recommendation doc. :rocket: 

anika: thanks, very actionable.

maya: end of thread — will update when experiments finish. :eyes:
